chunks: The exalted Sheikh Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Abu Ahmad Abd al-Aziz b. Yahya b. Ahmad b. Isa al-Juludi al-Basri narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Sahl narrated to us. He said: Al-Khidr b. Abi Fatima al-Balkhi narrated to us. He said: Wahib b. Nafi' narrated to us. He said: Kadih narrated to me from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them all).
Regarding His saying, the Mighty and Majestic: 'Peace be upon the Family of Yasin,' he said: Yasin is Muhammad (blessings of Allah upon him and his family), and we are the Family of Yasin.

key_terms.آلُ يَاسِينَ: Family of Yasin -- the Imams and descendants of the Prophet
key_terms.إِلْ يَاسِينَ: the Family of Yasin -- interpreted as the Ahl al-Bayt (Prophet's household)
key_terms.يَاسِينُ: Yasin -- identified as the Prophet Muhammad

ai.seo_question: What does 'Peace be upon the Family of Yasin' in Quran 37:130 mean according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Through a lengthy chain of narration reaching back to Imam Ali via Imam al-Sadiq, this hadith provides a Quranic exegesis of Surah al-Saffat 37:130, 'Peace be upon the Family of Yasin.' Imam Ali identifies Yasin as the Prophet Muhammad, making 'the Family of Yasin' a Quranic designation for the Ahl al-Bayt (the Prophet's household). This interpretation was significant for the original audience as it established Quranic authority for the special status of the Prophet's family -- a central point of Shia theology.
